source_title: Archie Lang: AFC Fylde sign ex-Bamber Bridge midfielder on two-year deal - BBC
source_excerpt:
AFC Fylde have signed midfielder Archie Lang on a two-year deal.
The 21-year-old joins, having left Bamber Bridge earlier this week, where he made a total of 15 appearances this season.
He could make his debut in Friday's National League fixture against Hornchurch, the club said.
"It's been a long time coming, but I'm really happy to be here, and I'm just ready to kick on now," he said.
"I want to push myself, and this feels like the right place to do so."
